quotations.old_english: Hé gewícode ðǽr ðǽr hé niéhst rýmet hæfde for wudufæstenne ond for wæterfæstenne
quotations.english: he encamped as near to the Danes as the wood and water, which protected their position, would allow him to find sufficient room

source_text: wæter-fæsten[n], es; n. A place protected by water :-- Hé gewícode ðǽr ðǽr hé niéhst rýmet hæfde for wudufæstenne ond for wæterfæstenne he encamped as near to the Danes as the wood and water, which protected their position, would allow him to find sufficient room, Chr. 894; Erl. 90, 10.
